blocks.text: BAYOMBONG, Nueva Vizcaya — A bus fell into a 70-meter-deep ravine along the national road in Diadi town, Nueva Vizcaya, at dawn on Wednesday, Sept. 16, police said. The bus was on its way to Pangasinan’s Dagupan City from Santiago City in Isabela when it suffered a mechanical problem while navigating the sharp climb and descent of a curved road near Sitio Ariwong in Nagsabaran village, said Police Captain Daryl Marquez, Diadi police chief.
